package.name: ia_tigris_search_planner
package.description: Single-agent IA-TIGRIS (Moon et al., IEEE T-RO 2026: an Incremental and Adaptive sampling-based planner for online informative path planning) as an AirStack global planner. A ROS-free C++17 port built on the tigris_search_planner TIGRIS port: the tree is kept between replans and recycled from the committed node (re-rooted, budget re-checked, rewards recomputed against the updated belief), rewards are computed incrementally from each node's sparse belief updates, and both the original entropy reward and the matched residual-belief reward are available (matched by default). It serves the mtl_msgs SearchMission interface, so the MTL follower and metrics logger fly and score it unchanged.
